what: [research harness defect] RQ-20261031-7b6f-03/-04/-05 (ADX-ceiling TRANSFER AX40/AX50 to ict_scalp_sol_15m / xrp_15m / xrp_5m) pass --adx-max=40/50 as a raw harness flag, but scripts/backtest_ict_scalp.py has NO --adx-max argument (its argparse list, 2026-11-01), so every candidate arm aborts with 'unrecognized arguments' -> harness_failed, never a verdict. Fix: either add an ADX ceiling to backtest_ict_scalp.py (+ the _SCALP_LEVER_FLAG map) and keep the units, or retire the three units with this reason. Iteration units RQ-20261101-78fc-48/-49/-50 deliberately use only flags the scalp harness has.
